title: Forge-less runner (level a, loopback over a fake SSH transport to the real host entrypoint): an exact-head job stores its result and prints a runner reference, logs stay on the host and come back by job id, and the capture names host, job and head; the host sees only seed, job and result over the hardened argv, its job env is scrubbed of tokens and crew variables, it has no forge remote, no gh or engine call and no role verb; a duplicate job id or request id returns the first job and a lost reply never runs a second; a red remote test is a red run; unreachable, refused and failed transport run the same commands locally and name the reason, and a late result is discarded; a stale head, a capture at another head and an unseeded head are refused

steps.name: loopback-pass-stores-result-and-reference-logs
steps.run: SRC={source} ST={state_dir} RUN={run_id}; . $SRC/scripts/fixtures/campaign/a23/lib.sh; export GH_TOKEN=a23-decoy GITHUB_TOKEN=a23-decoy SSH_AUTH_SOCK=/nonexistent/agent; h=$(tip); out=$(runner $h --host loop); rc=$?; echo "$out"; j=$(job "$out"); test $rc -eq 0 && echo "$out" | grep -qx "runner:loop/${h%${h#???????}}-[0-9a-f]\{12\} head=$h" && echo "$out" | grep -qx 'check-repo exit 0' && echo "$out" | grep -qx 'tests exit 0' || exit 1; python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); assert (d["host"], d["head"], [c["exit"] for c in d["commands"]]) == ("loop", sys.argv[2], [0, 0]), d; print("stored", d["host"], d["job_id"], [c["log"] for c in d["commands"]])' $S/runner/$j/result.json $h || exit 1; ls $H/host-loop/jobs/$j/0-check-repo.log $H/host-loop/jobs/$j/1-tests.log || exit 1; l=$(logs $j check-repo); echo "$l"; echo "$l" | grep -qx "== check-repo exit 0 (jobs/$j/0-check-repo.log)" && echo "$l" | grep -q "^sample check-repo ok in .*/host-loop/jobs/$j/wt$" || exit 1; c=$(capture $S/runner/$j/result.json); echo "$c"; echo "$c" | grep -q "^Proof T1 · \`runner:loop/$j\` · head \`$h\`" && echo "$c" | grep -qx 'result: pass' && test ! -e $A23_LOCAL_LOG

steps.name: runner-host-never-uses-forge-or-roles
steps.run: SRC={source} ST={state_dir} RUN={run_id}; . $SRC/scripts/fixtures/campaign/a23/lib.sh; j=$(field job job_id | tail -1); v=$(python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(" ".join(sorted({r["verb"] for r in map(json.loads, open(sys.argv[1]))})))' $L); echo "verbs: $v"; test "$v" = 'job result seed' || exit 1; python3 -c 'import json,sys; print("ssh argv:", " ".join(json.loads(open(sys.argv[1]).readline())["argv"]))' $L; python3 -c 'import json,sys; a=[r["argv"] for r in map(json.loads, open(sys.argv[1]))]; assert all(x[:3] == ["-F", "none", "-T"] and "-a" in x and "-x" in x and "ClearAllForwardings=yes" in x and "BatchMode=yes" in x and x[-1] == "crew-host" for x in a), a' $L || exit 1; e=$(grep '^env: ' $H/host-loop/jobs/$j/0-check-repo.log); echo "host job $e"; test "$e" = 'env: clean' || exit 1; echo "gh calls: $(wc -l < $ST/gh.log | tr -d ' '), engine stub calls: $(wc -l < $ST/stub.log | tr -d ' '), mirror remotes: [$(git -C $H/host-loop/mirrors/campaign__sandbox-$RUN.git remote)], role worktrees: [$(ls $H/host-loop/wt)]"; test ! -s $ST/gh.log && test ! -s $ST/stub.log && test -z "$(git -C $H/host-loop/mirrors/campaign__sandbox-$RUN.git remote)" && test -z "$(ls $H/host-loop/wt)" || exit 1; o=$(call loop '{"verb": "spawn", "version": "dev", "request_id": "a23-spawn", "root": "'$H/host-loop'"}'); echo "spawn: $o"; echo "$o" | grep -q '"reason": "verb spawn not built on this host"'

steps.name: duplicate-job-and-request-id-return-first
steps.run: SRC={source} ST={state_dir} RUN={run_id}; . $SRC/scripts/fixtures/campaign/a23/lib.sh; h=$(tip); m=$(git -C $R rev-parse main); rq() { call loop '{"verb": "job", "version": "dev", "request_id": "'$1'", "root": "'$H/host-loop'", "project": "campaign__sandbox-'$RUN'", "job_id": "a23-dup", "head": "'$2'", "commands": [{"command": "check-repo"}]}'; }; a=$(rq r1 $h); b=$(rq r2 $m); c=$(rq r1 $m); echo "first:   $a"; echo "new rid: $b"; echo "same rid: $c"; echo "$a" | grep -q '"status": "running"' && echo "$b" | grep -q '"retried": true' && echo "$b" | grep -q "\"head\": \"$h\"" && test "$c" = "$a" && test $(ls $H/host-loop/jobs | grep -c '^a23-dup$') -eq 1 || exit 1; n=$(ls $H/host-loop/jobs | wc -l); fault loop job lost; out=$(runner $h --host loop); rc=$?; echo "$out"; r=$(field job request_id | tail -2 | sort -u | wc -l | tr -d ' '); f=$(field job fault | tail -2 | tr '\n' ' '); echo "job calls: faults $f, distinct request ids $r, host jobs +$(( $(ls $H/host-loop/jobs | wc -l) - n ))"; test $rc -eq 0 && echo "$out" | grep -q '^runner:loop/' && test "$f" = 'lost None ' && test $r -eq 1 && test $(ls $H/host-loop/jobs | wc -l) -eq $((n + 1)) && ! echo "$out" | grep -q 'ran locally'

steps.name: remote-red-test-stays-red
steps.run: SRC={source} ST={state_dir} RUN={run_id}; . $SRC/scripts/fixtures/campaign/a23/lib.sh; red True || exit 1; h=$(tip); out=$(runner $h --host loop); rc=$?; echo "$out"; j=$(job "$out"); test $rc -eq 1 && echo "$out" | grep -qx 'tests exit 1' && echo "$out" | grep -qx 'check-repo exit 0' && ! echo "$out" | grep -q 'ran locally' && test ! -e $A23_LOCAL_LOG || exit 1; l=$(logs $j tests); echo "$l"; echo "$l" | grep -qx 'test-a23 FAILED: red at head' || exit 1; c=$(capture $j); echo "$c"; echo "$c" | grep -qx 'result: red' && echo "$c" | grep -qx -- '--- tests exit 1'

steps.name: unreachable-falls-back-locally-late-result-discarded
steps.run: SRC={source} ST={state_dir} RUN={run_id}; . $SRC/scripts/fixtures/campaign/a23/lib.sh; h=$(tip); fault loop result down; fault loop result down; fault loop result down; out=$(runner $h --host loop); rc=$?; echo "$out"; j=$(field job job_id | tail -1); test $rc -eq 1 && echo "$out" | grep -qx 'runner: loop unreachable; ran locally' && echo "$out" | grep -qx "local head=$h" && echo "$out" | grep -qx 'tests exit 1' || exit 1; echo "local ran: $(tr '\n' ';' < $A23_LOCAL_LOG)"; test "$(cat $A23_LOCAL_LOG)" = "$(printf 'check-repo.py\nrun-tests.py scripts/test-a23.py')" || exit 1; for i in $(seq 100); do test -e $H/host-loop/jobs/$j/result.json && break; sleep 0.1; done; echo "late host result: $(ls $H/host-loop/jobs/$j/result.json); stored: $(ls $S/runner/$j 2>&1)"; test -e $H/host-loop/jobs/$j/result.json && test ! -e $S/runner/$j

steps.name: refused-and-failed-transport-fall-back-with-reason
steps.run: SRC={source} ST={state_dir} RUN={run_id}; . $SRC/scripts/fixtures/campaign/a23/lib.sh; red False || exit 1; h=$(tip); rm -f $A23_LOCAL_LOG; a=$(runner $h --host skew); ra=$?; b=$(runner $h --host gone); rb=$?; c=$(runner $h); rc=$?; echo "$a"; echo "$b"; echo "$c"; test $ra$rb$rc = 000 && echo "$a" | grep -qx 'runner: skew refused: version skew: host v0.0.1, call dev; ran locally' && echo "$b" | grep -qx 'runner: gone failed: entrypoint exit 127: no structured reply; ran locally' || exit 1; echo "$c" | grep -qx 'runner: no forge-less host; ran locally' && echo 'KNOWN #743: no check verb on the host entrypoint, so automatic pick finds no ready forge-less host' || exit 1; test $(grep -c '^check-repo.py$' $A23_LOCAL_LOG) -eq 3 && test $(grep -cx 'run-tests.py scripts/test-a23.py' $A23_LOCAL_LOG) -eq 3 && echo "$a$b$c" | grep -qx "local head=$h"

steps.name: stale-sha-rejected
steps.run: SRC={source} ST={state_dir} RUN={run_id}; . $SRC/scripts/fixtures/campaign/a23/lib.sh; h=$(tip); old=$(git -C $R rev-parse HEAD~1); n=$(wc -l < $L); out=$(runner $old --host loop); rc=$?; echo "$out"; test $rc -eq 2 && echo "$out" | grep -qx "crew runner: the checkout is at $h, not --head $old" && test $(wc -l < $L) -eq $n || exit 1; j=$(python3 -c 'import json,os,sys; print(next(d for d in os.listdir(sys.argv[1]) if json.load(open(os.path.join(sys.argv[1], d, "result.json")))["head"] == sys.argv[2]))' $S/runner $old); c=$(capture $j 2>&1); rc=$?; echo "$c"; test $rc -eq 2 && echo "$c" | grep -qx "evidence-cli: runner result is at $old, not the checkout head $h; it does not count" || exit 1; u=$(git -C $R commit-tree -p $h -m unseeded $(git -C $R rev-parse $h^{tree})); o=$(call loop '{"verb": "job", "version": "dev", "request_id": "a23-stale", "root": "'$H/host-loop'", "project": "campaign__sandbox-'$RUN'", "job_id": "a23-stale", "head": "'$u'", "commands": [{"command": "check-repo"}]}'); echo "unseeded head: $o"; echo "$o" | grep -q '"reason": "head not in the host mirror"' && test ! -e $H/host-loop/jobs/a23-stale
